title: KIA/KPDF Recapture Lonton Camp Near Indawgyi, Kachin State
detail: The Kachin Independence Army and Kachin People's Defence Force jointly recaptured Lonton camp (lost to junta forces in June) in the Indawgyi area, Mohnyin Township, Kachin State, from combined junta and Southern Alliance-militia (SNA) forces on July 17, 2026, inflicting heavy casualties. Weapons, ammunition, and electronic jamming equipment were seized or destroyed; six SNA militia bodies were recovered and given Buddhist burials on July 18.

media.caption: KIA and KPDF recapture Lonton camp near Indawgyi, Kachin State.

title: KNU Battles Junta Column Near Myawaddy; MNDAA-Junta Lashio Talks Collapse in Kunming
detail: In Karen State, KNU/KNLA-led resistance forces engaged junta columns using aircraft, suicide drones, and heavy artillery near Myawaddy; resistance forces reported capturing soldiers and weapons despite the junta's numerical advantage, while junta troops deliberately destroyed civilian homes and forced civilian recruitment. Separately, in Sagaing Region's Kanbalu Township, local People's Defence Organisation and allied forces attacked a joint junta-Pyu Saw Htee militia unit on the Kar Bo-Kyi Kone road around 6:30am, killing 5 and injuring 8 on the junta/militia side with no resistance casualties. In parallel diplomatic developments, MNDAA resumed talks with the regime in Kunming over territorial control of Lashio; the junta demanded return of the whole township while MNDAA offered only partial wards, and talks ended in an impasse.

media.caption: KNU battles junta column near Myawaddy as MNDAA-junta Lashio talks stall in Kunming.
